description: This file defines the Border class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for parsing and handling border styles in XML representations of spreadsheet styles. It includes constants for border position and style mappings, and methods for parsing style data from XML elements.

classes.name: Border
classes.description: Represents and parses border styles from XML, mapping style identifiers to PhpSpreadsheet border styles, and handling border position and diagonal directions.

methods.name: parseStyle
methods.description: Parses border style data from a SimpleXMLElement, returning an array describing border positions, colors, and styles.

methods.name: parsePosition
methods.description: Determines border position and diagonal direction based on style attribute values.
